additional_analysis.cohort: Programme cohort, n=995; same cleaned master as the notebook
additional_analysis.anchor: At 6 months, all timing tiers; complete pairs for each clinical measure
additional_analysis.clinical_intervals: Paired mean change with 95% Student t interval
additional_analysis.rate_intervals: Wilson 95% interval; missing outcomes excluded, not imputed
additional_analysis.baseline_hba1c: Two strata: >6.5% versus ≤6.5%; 27 missing baseline HbA1c excluded
additional_analysis.g1_revision: G1 now requires no baseline glucose-lowering drug AND HbA1c >6.5% (89). Notebook G1 included all 114 drug-naive patients; 21 with HbA1c ≤6.5% and 4 missing are excluded from the revised G1.
additional_analysis.g2: On glucose-lowering medication at baseline AND HbA1c ≥6.5% (564)
additional_analysis.g3: On glucose-lowering medication at baseline AND HbA1c <6.5% (229)
additional_analysis.subgroup_exclusions: 113 outside the displayed groups or missing baseline data; not all 113 are missing data
additional_analysis.insulin_split: G2 baseline insulin use: 27 using, 537 not using, 0 missing. Insulin use may include oral medication.
additional_analysis.remission: Stop dates are unavailable: the HbA1c measurement cannot be verified as at least 3 months after drug cessation. These are joint outcome proxies, not confirmed remission.

sender_analysis.grouping: The programme master source_file joins to new_filename or original_filename; aggregate by the mapping sender, not facility or source_family.
sender_analysis.scope: Programme cohort only, n=995, 21 retained source files, 8 senders; all records mapped. Registry n=1461 and survey n=214 remain excluded.
sender_analysis.interpretation: Sender may cover several treating facilities. These are descriptive within-programme comparisons; case mix, completeness and timing differ across senders.
sender_analysis.anchor: At 6 months, all timing tiers; same outcome eligibility and complete-pair definitions as the overall slides.
sender_analysis.reconciliation: Sender event counts, denominators, group counts and missingness sum to the overall tables. Clinical means and changes reproduce overall estimates when weighted by complete-pair counts.
sender_analysis.small_groups: n=0: means, rates and intervals are null. n=1: paired means and change are shown without a confidence interval. n≥2: paired 95% Student t interval. Counts and missingness are always retained.
sender_analysis.rate_intervals: Wilson 95% interval. Missing outcomes are excluded from denominators, not imputed as failures.
sender_analysis.remission: Joint cessation and HbA1c <6.5% is not confirmed remission: no stop dates establish at least 3 months without medication before HbA1c measurement.
